attempts.summary: Locked curl at its current version (8.9.1-5.el10) on node1 using dnf versionlock (installed the plugin, added the lock), verified it excludes curl from a simulated system update, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued an async systemctl reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id post-restart, and re-verified curl's version and the versionlock rule persisted and still exclude curl from updates.
